title: The July Call – Submission of the Ignored HMRC Threat
description: On 21 June 2024, Ben Carter made a call reporting escalating abuse, including threats already carried out by Alanna O’Hare — such as contacting HMRC and making defamatory claims to his injury lawyer. This call, later referred to as 'The July Call', detailed ongoing coercion, reputational harm, and psychological targeting. Despite the precision of the report and its forensic detail, Sussex Police never investigated it. When the call was re-referenced in July, then November, police claimed it had been lost or not logged. This entry anchors the moment when safeguarding could have begun but was willfully bypassed.
category: Safeguarding Failure → Ignored Disclosures → Threats Already Carried Out
public_summary: Ben Carter warned Sussex Police that Alanna had already begun executing threats — including contacting HMRC. They ignored the call. Months later, police would claim they couldn’t locate it — but the damage had already begun.
